lines.en: We left early so that we could avoid the traffic, and we still got stuck on the bridge, Ben.

lines.en: I took the train in order to save time, so that I could prepare my presentation on the way.

lines.en: Smart. I always carry a book so that I don’t get bored in a queue, and a charger so that my phone never dies.

lines.en: Last weekend I walked along Granville Street so that I could photograph the old neon signs.

lines.en: Beautiful. I came to Vancouver in order to study, and I stayed so that I could be near the mountains.

lines.en: I work from home on Fridays so that I can ski in the morning. I do it in order to relax.

lines.en: Lucky you. I wear a raincoat every day so that I don’t get wet, and I carry an umbrella just in case.

facts.big: in order to + verbo / so that + sujeito + verbo
facts.label: Finalidade
facts.sub: In order to + base: I left early in order to avoid traffic. So that + sujeito: so that we could avoid it. Negativa: so that I don’t / in order not to.

facts.label: Para (finalidade)
facts.sub: In order to + verbo base explica a finalidade: I took the train in order to save time. Também pode ser só to: I took the train to save time. A forma negativa é in order not to.

facts.label: Para que
facts.sub: So that + sujeito + verbo: We left early so that we could avoid traffic. Use can/could ou o presente. O sujeito pode ser outro: I left so that you could rest.

facts.label: Could e can
facts.sub: No passado, use so that + could. No presente, use so that + can ou o presente: I work from home so that I can ski. Mantenha a mesma lógica de tempo.

facts.label: So that … don’t

items.s: In order to is followed by the base verb.
items.why: Yes.

items.s: So that is followed by an infinitive without a subject.
items.why: So that needs a subject and a verb.

items.s: “So that we could” is used for past purposes.
items.why: Yes.

pages.title: A rainy morning in Vancouver · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a grey, rainy morning in Vancouver. Abby has a long commute. Her friend Ben prefers the train. Both of them have reasons for their choices. They meet in a café. They explain why they do things.

“We left early so that we could avoid the traffic, and we still got stuck on the bridge, Ben.” says Abby. “I took the train in order to save time, so that I could prepare my presentation on the way.” says Ben. “Smart. I always carry a book so that I don’t get bored in a queue, and a charger so that my phone never dies.” says Abby.

pages.model: I wear a raincoat so that I don’t get wet.

solo: Aluno diz a frase com 3 combinações.
group: Padrão: “I wear a raincoat so that I {verb} {thing}.”. Nota: So that I don’t + verbo.
Cada aluno troca um espaço: don’t get, don’t feel, can stay.
extra90: Peça a versão negativa ou em pergunta.

pages.title: Escreva a sua versão
pages.task: Escreva 4 frases explicando o que você faz e por quê.
pages.model: I left early so that I could avoid traffic. I took the train in order to save time. I carry a charger so that my phone never dies. I wear a raincoat so that I don’t get wet.
checks: Usou: dizer a finalidade com in order to.
Usou: dizer a finalidade com so that.

solo: Corrija só 2–3 pontos prioritários e mostre uma forma mais natural.
group: Tarefa: Escreva 4 frases explicando o que você faz e por quê.
Modelo: “I left early so that I could avoid traffic. I took the train in order to save time. I carry a charger so that my phone…”.
Troquem textos e corrijam em duplas.
extra90: Leitura em voz alta de uma frase de cada aluno.
answers: Usou: dizer a finalidade com in order to.
Usou: dizer a finalidade com so that.
Usou: evitar algo.

items.cue: Deixo os fones em casa para poder conversar com as pessoas. Para conhecer alguém, é preciso levantar o olhar.
items.target: I leave my headphones at home so that I can talk to people. In order to meet someone, you have to look up.

items.cue: No fim de semana passado andei pela Granville Street para poder fotografar os velhos letreiros de néon.
items.target: Last weekend I walked along Granville Street so that I could photograph the old neon signs.

items.cue: Trabalho de casa às sextas para poder esquiar de manhã. Faço isso para relaxar.
items.target: I work from home on Fridays so that I can ski in the morning. I do it in order to relax.

solo: Aluno responde; você explica o porquê.
group: Cada aluno responde antes de ver a correção.
Explique o “por quê” de cada resposta em uma frase.
extra90: Peça que digam a resposta em voz alta com a frase inteira.
